raw_segments.text: In the street the heat was insufferable again, not a drop of rain had fallen all those days.
Again dust, bricks and mortar, again the stench from the shops and pothouses, again the drunken
men, the Finnish peddlers and half-broken-down cabs.
The sun shone straight in his eyes, so that it hurt him to look out of them, and he felt
his head going round as a man in a fever is apt to feel when he comes out into the street
